# Governance Compliance Checklist

**Purpose**: Validate governance compliance requirements quality — fail-loudly disposition, entity-resolution audit logs, score isolation, credential security, and idempotency guarantees
**Created**: 2026-07-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by `/speckit.checklist` based on feature context from spec.md, plan.md, and tasks.md.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are target-disposition log-level requirements (INFO vs WARNING vs ERROR) specified for every possible pipeline outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for the exact format of `"neo4j_failed": true` when Neo4j is unreachable versus when schema constraints are missing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK003 Are entity-resolution merge logging requirements defined for all three match types (phone match, fuzzy match ≥90, sub-threshold <90)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004]
- [ ] CHK004 Are `lead_score_breakdown` schema requirements (JSON structure, field types, null handling) specified for both SQLite and Neo4j? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK005 Are credential-scoping requirements specified for all credential types (proxy URLs, API keys, DB passwords, Neo4j URIs) or only the four named in §FR-007? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK006 Are checkpoint resume-and-recover requirements specified for crash scenarios (mid-request, mid-write, mid-enrichment)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK007 Are idempotency requirements specified for every pipeline phase (scraping, enrichment, deduplication, scoring, Neo4j write) or only for re-run counts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for the 30% failure threshold promotion block mentioned in the constitution? [Completeness, §Constitution V]
- [ ] CHK009 Are requirements specified for the `rejected_duplicates` log mentioned in the constitution's idempotency section? [Completeness, §Constitution IV]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 Is "clear one-line reason" (FR-001) quantified with an exact format specification or left to implementer judgment? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the `neo4j_failed` flag type specified (boolean vs integer, present only on failure vs always present)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the fuzzy-match log line format specified unambiguously — which timestamp format, which delimiter between fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK013 Are the SQLite column types for `lead_score` and `lead_score_breakdown` specified (INTEGER vs REAL for score, TEXT vs JSON for breakdown)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [ ] CHK014 Is "real credential values" (FR-007) precisely defined — does it cover partial strings, encoded values, or only verbatim secrets? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK015 Is "identical counts" (FR-008) defined for all three data stores (Neo4j nodes, Neo4j relationships, SQLite rows) or only one? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the `crawldir` path requirement specified as absolute or relative? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the distinction between checkpoint directories and `debug_output/` directories clarified, or are both covered by FR-010? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK018 Do FR-001's "INFO or WARNING" disposition logging levels conflict with the constitution's "fail loudly" requirement for ERROR-level Neo4j failures? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001 vs §Constitution V]
- [ ] CHK019 Are entity-resolution entity definitions (ScrapeTarget, EntityResolutionLog) consistent with their use in requirements FR-001 through FR-004? [Consistency, Spec §Key Entities vs §FR-001–004]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the success criterion "under 30 seconds" (SC-001) conflict with any other requirement's implied complexity? [Consistency, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the score isolation boundary (dashboard HTML vs embedded JSON vs JS, FR-006) consistently stated across the spec, or do §SC-003 and §Edge Cases use different scopes? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §SC-003, §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Are credential patterns in SC-004 (`proxy.*http`, `neo4j.*://`, `password`) consistent with the env-var names listed in §FR-007 acceptance scenario 1 (`WEBSHARE_PROXY_URL`, `RESIDENTIAL_PROXY`, `NEO4J_URI`, `NEO4J_PASSWORD`)? [Consistency, Spec §SC-004 vs §FR-007]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK023 Can SC-001 ("under 30 seconds") be objectively measured in a CI environment without a stopwatch? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK024 Is SC-002's "parseable by a human reviewer" verifiable as a CI gate, or is it aspirational? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK025 Can SC-004 "zero false positives" be achieved given that `password` occurs in SQL connection strings and library source? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK026 Are SC-005's "identical counts" gated on exact equality or tolerance-based (e.g., within 1 due to timestamp updates)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK027 Does acceptance scenario 3 (US5, crash mid-phase) have a measurable test given that checkpoint resume is not exercised in the existing 352-test suite? [Measurability, Spec §US5-AS3]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK028 Are requirements defined for partial failure scenarios — e.g., Neo4j write succeeds for some records but fails for others? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements specified for the case when only some credential types are configured (proxy set but Neo4j not)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK030 Are concurrent-write scenarios covered — what happens if two pipeline instances run against the same Neo4j database? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements defined for the "all 3 sites" multi-source scoring tier when only 2 sites are configured? [Coverage, §Constitution — Scoring]
- [ ] CHK032 Are ip address rotation requirements specified for proxy management when Webshare pool is exhausted? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK033 Is the behavior specified when `debug_output/fuzzy_matches.log` is on a read-only filesystem? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases — log file locked]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the behavior specified when Neo4j is reachable but schema indexes are missing or stale? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases — schema constraints missing]
- [ ] CHK035 Is the behavior specified when a company name exceeds the fuzzy-matching reasonable length (e.g., 500+ characters)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the behavior specified when rapidfuzz `token_sort_ratio` raises an exception on malformed input? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the behavior specified when both `.scrapling_checkpoints/` and `debug_output/` directories already exist from a prior run? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK038 Is the behavior specified when GitHub Actions cron triggers the pipeline but neo4j pin step fails? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK039 Is the behavior specified when `dedup_key` normalization produces collisions across distinct companies? [Edge Case, §Constitution — Dedup Key]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK040 Is the sole-writer assumption (no concurrent Neo4j writes) validated or documented as a risk? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK041 Is the `debug_output/` gitignore assumption verified, or does the spec assume it without confirmation? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK042 Is the "standard patterns" credential-scan assumption clearly scoped, or could it miss obfuscated credentials? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK043 Is the existing-352-tests assumption specified as a non-regression constraint in the acceptance criteria? [Dependency, Spec §Constraints]
- [ ] CHK044 Is the Neo4j driver dependency version (`neo4j==5.20.0`) documented as a hard constraint, or is it an implementation detail in the plan only? [Dependency, Spec §Gap]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`
- Items marked `[Gap]` indicate areas where the spec may need additional requirements
- Items marked `[Ambiguity]` indicate terms that need quantification or precision
- This checklist focuses on requirements quality, not implementation correctness
